meanings.en: the act of starting to become aware of or understand something
meanings.exampleEn: The book led to a political awakening among young readers.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap, genç okurlar arasında siyasi bir uyanışa yol açtı.

meanings.en: the act of waking up from sleep
meanings.exampleEn: Her sudden awakening was caused by a loud noise.
meanings.exampleTr: Ani uyanışına yüksek bir ses neden oldu.

meanings.en: to decide not to do something you had agreed to do
meanings.exampleEn: He backed out of the deal at the last minute.
meanings.exampleTr: Son dakikada anlaşmadan caydı.

meanings.tr: eski kötü alışkanlıklarına geri dönmek, gerilemek
meanings.en: to return to a worse or less moral way of behaving after making improvements
meanings.exampleEn: After a month of dieting, she began to backslide into old habits.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir aylık diyetin ardından eski alışkanlıklarına geri dönmeye başladı.

meanings.tr: geçmişe dönük, geriye bakan; ilerlemeye kapalı
meanings.en: considering the past rather than planning for the future; not modern
meanings.exampleEn: Critics called the policy backward-looking and out of touch.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler politikayı geçmişe dönük ve çağdışı olarak nitelendirdi.

meanings.en: a bad or evil character in a film, book, or story
meanings.exampleEn: In the movie, the baddie is finally defeated by the hero.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmde kötü adam sonunda kahraman tarafından yenilir.

meanings.en: having the round shape of a ball
meanings.exampleEn: The plant produces small, ball-shaped fruits.
meanings.exampleTr: Bitki küçük, top şeklinde meyveler verir.

meanings.en: a row of posts with a rail on top, along the edge of stairs, a balcony, or a bridge
meanings.exampleEn: She leaned against the stone balustrade of the balcony.
meanings.exampleTr: Balkonun taş korkuluğuna yaslandı.

meanings.en: an armed robber, especially one belonging to a group that attacks travelers
meanings.exampleEn: The travelers were attacked by a bandit on the mountain road.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolcular dağ yolunda bir haydut tarafından saldırıya uğradı.

meanings.en: friendly, playful teasing conversation
meanings.exampleEn: There was a lot of banter between the two teammates.
meanings.exampleTr: İki takım arkadaşı arasında bolca şakalaşma vardı.

meanings.tr: davetsizce içeri dalmak; söze pat diye girmek
meanings.en: to enter a place or interrupt rudely and suddenly
meanings.exampleEn: She barged in without knocking on the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapıyı çalmadan içeri daldı.

meanings.en: a man belonging to a low rank of the nobility
meanings.exampleEn: The baron owned vast areas of land in the region.
meanings.exampleTr: Baron, bölgede geniş arazilere sahipti.

meanings.tr: kodaman, patron (belirli bir sektörde çok güçlü kişi)
meanings.en: a person who controls a large part of a particular industry
meanings.exampleEn: He became a powerful media baron in the 1980s.
meanings.exampleTr: 1980'lerde güçlü bir medya kodamanı oldu.

meanings.en: land where plants cannot grow because the soil is poor
meanings.exampleEn: Nothing could grow on the dry, barren land.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuru, çorak toprakta hiçbir şey yetişemezdi.

meanings.en: a temporary barrier built to block a road or entrance, especially during fighting
meanings.exampleEn: Protesters built a barricade across the street.
meanings.exampleTr: Protestocular sokağa bir barikat kurdular.

meanings.en: to block or defend something with a barrier
meanings.exampleEn: They barricaded the door to keep the intruders out.
meanings.exampleTr: İzinsiz girenleri dışarıda tutmak için kapıyı barikatla kapattılar.

meanings.en: people who are swimming or relaxing in water for pleasure
meanings.exampleEn: The beach was full of bathers on the hot summer day.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcak yaz gününde plaj yüzen insanlarla doluydu.

meanings.en: to not be present in a place
meanings.exampleEn: Three students were absent from class today.
meanings.exampleTr: Bugün üç öğrenci derste yoktu.

meanings.en: to come into existence by birth
meanings.exampleEn: She was born in a small village in 1990.
meanings.exampleTr: 1990 yılında küçük bir köyde doğdu.

meanings.en: to give attention to what you are doing in order to avoid harm or mistakes
meanings.exampleEn: Be careful when you cross the busy road.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık yoldan geçerken dikkatli ol.

meanings.en: to feel certain that something is true
meanings.exampleEn: I am convinced that he is telling the truth.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun doğruyu söylediğine eminim.

meanings.tr: kuşkulu olmak, şüphe duymak, emin olmamak
meanings.en: to feel uncertain about something
meanings.exampleEn: I am doubtful that the plan will work.
meanings.exampleTr: Planın işe yarayacağından kuşkuluyum.

meanings.en: to have doubts about something; to be uncertain
meanings.exampleEn: She was dubious about the safety of the old bridge.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski köprünün güvenliğinden kuşkuluydu.

meanings.tr: hayal gücü kuvvetli olmak, yaratıcı olmak
meanings.en: to be good at thinking of new and original ideas
meanings.exampleEn: Children tend to be imaginative when they play.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar oynarken hayal güçleri kuvvetli olma eğilimindedir.

meanings.en: to be good at inventing things or thinking of new ideas
meanings.exampleEn: You have to be inventive to solve problems with so few resources.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar az kaynakla sorunları çözmek için yaratıcı olmalısın.

meanings.en: to have the duty of dealing with or taking care of something
meanings.exampleEn: Parents are responsible for their children's safety.
meanings.exampleTr: Ebeveynler çocuklarının güvenliğinden sorumludur.

meanings.en: to share qualities but not be exactly the same
meanings.exampleEn: The two languages are similar in many ways.
meanings.exampleTr: İki dil birçok yönden benzerdir.

meanings.en: to feel grateful for something
meanings.exampleEn: We should be thankful for what we have.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahip olduklarımız için minnettar olmalıyız.

meanings.en: to not show or feel thanks for something received
meanings.exampleEn: It would be ungrateful to refuse their generous offer.
meanings.exampleTr: Cömert tekliflerini reddetmek nankörlük olurdu.

meanings.en: a small, usually round piece of glass, wood, or plastic with a hole through it, used for making jewelry
meanings.exampleEn: She threaded each bead onto the string to make a necklace.
meanings.exampleTr: Kolye yapmak için her boncuğu ipe geçirdi.

meanings.en: a small drop of liquid
meanings.exampleEn: Beads of sweat formed on his forehead.
meanings.exampleTr: Alnında ter damlaları oluştu.

meanings.en: defeated in a game, fight, or competition
meanings.exampleEn: The beaten team left the field in silence.
meanings.exampleTr: Yenilen takım sessizce sahayı terk etti.

meanings.en: mixed or stirred quickly (e.g. eggs)
meanings.exampleEn: Add the beaten eggs to the flour mixture.
meanings.exampleTr: Çırpılmış yumurtaları un karışımına ekleyin.

meanings.en: items such as make-up and skin care used to improve appearance
meanings.exampleEn: The store sells a wide range of beauty products.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza geniş bir yelpazede güzellik ürünleri satıyor.

meanings.en: stopped existing as a species (past tense of become extinct)
meanings.exampleEn: The dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
meanings.exampleTr: Dinozorların nesli milyonlarca yıl önce tükendi.

meanings.en: a person who lives by asking others for money or food
meanings.exampleEn: A beggar sat outside the station asking for coins.
meanings.exampleTr: İstasyonun dışında oturan bir dilenci bozuk para istiyordu.

meanings.en: to start something once more from the beginning
meanings.exampleEn: After the mistake, they had to begin again from the start.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatadan sonra en baştan yeniden başlamak zorunda kaldılar.

meanings.en: past participle of 'begin'; to have started
meanings.exampleEn: The meeting had already begun when I arrived.
meanings.exampleTr: Ben vardığımda toplantı çoktan başlamıştı.

meanings.en: a hollow green, red, or yellow vegetable with a mild flavor
meanings.exampleEn: She chopped a red bell pepper for the salad.
meanings.exampleTr: Salata için kırmızı bir dolmalık biber doğradı.

meanings.tr: otel komisi, otel valesi (bavul taşıyan görevli)
meanings.en: a hotel employee who carries guests' bags and does small tasks
meanings.exampleEn: The bellhop carried our luggage up to the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel komisi bavullarımızı odaya kadar taşıdı.

meanings.en: wishing to fight or argue; hostile and aggressive
meanings.exampleEn: He became belligerent after a few drinks.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç içkiden sonra saldırganlaştı.

meanings.en: a person who receives money, advantages, or benefits from something
meanings.exampleEn: She was named as the main beneficiary of the will.
meanings.exampleTr: Vasiyetnamenin ana lehtarı olarak belirlendi.

meanings.en: not harmful; (of a tumor) not cancerous
meanings.exampleEn: The tests showed that the tumor was benign.
meanings.exampleTr: Testler tümörün iyi huylu olduğunu gösterdi.

meanings.en: kind and gentle in nature
meanings.exampleEn: He had a benign smile that put everyone at ease.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesi rahatlatan müşfik bir gülümsemesi vardı.

meanings.en: money or property that you leave to someone in your will
meanings.exampleEn: The museum received a generous bequest from a former patron.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, eski bir hamiden cömert bir miras aldı.

meanings.en: a bed on a ship or train
meanings.exampleEn: We booked a cabin with two berths for the overnight journey.
meanings.exampleTr: Gece yolculuğu için iki yataklı bir kabin ayırttık.

meanings.tr: rıhtımda geminin bağlanma yeri, yanaşma yeri
meanings.en: a place in a port where a ship can stop and stay
meanings.exampleEn: The ship pulled into its berth at the harbor.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi limandaki yanaşma yerine girdi.

meanings.en: to ask someone for something in an urgent and emotional way
meanings.exampleEn: She beseeched the judge to show mercy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yargıçtan merhamet göstermesi için yalvardı.

meanings.en: a friendly expression of hope for someone's happiness or success, often used to end a message
meanings.exampleEn: Please give my best wishes to your family.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen ailene en iyi dileklerimi ilet.

meanings.en: most popular and admired
meanings.exampleEn: It is one of the country's best-loved children's stories.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin en sevilen çocuk hikayelerinden biridir.

meanings.en: the act of being disloyal to someone who trusts you
meanings.exampleEn: She felt his lie was a deep betrayal of their friendship.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun yalanının dostluklarına derin bir ihanet olduğunu hissetti.

meanings.en: to express great sadness or regret about something
meanings.exampleEn: The workers bewailed the loss of their jobs.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler işlerini kaybetmenin yasını tuttu.
